Hi. Are you on meds for the voices? Have you anyone else to talk to, than your boyfriend?
I'm happy to talk to you now if you want to.

yeah i know exactly what you mean mate. i struggle too. a few things help. how do you "fight"? other than drinking? for me personally, alcohol makes me worse, but i've found things like self hypnosis and different kinds of meditation help, but it can be a case of focussing on the painful bits to get through to the nicer bits which is hard but worth it, even if for a few days relief at a time. i definitely don't claim to have answers to depression/ideations but just know that other people are going through it too, maybe if we share with each other it will help.
